data.detail: The Red Sox outrighted Kelly (elbow) to Triple-A Worcester on Friday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
data.name: Zack Kelly

data.detail: Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said Tuesday that Gonzalez is still recovering from a hyperextended elbow injury suffered at Triple-A Worcester but is "very much in play" for the ALDS roster if Boston advances, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.
data.name: Romy Gonzalez

data.detail: The Red Sox transferred White (foot) to the 60-day injured list Sunday.
data.name: Eli White

data.detail: The Red Sox transferred Slaten (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Tuesday, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
data.name: Justin Slaten

data.detail: Casas (abdomen/knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Thursday.
data.name: Triston Casas

data.detail: Crawford (forearm) is expected to remain on the injured list for the rest of the season, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.
data.name: Kutter Crawford

data.detail: The Red Sox exercised Whitlock's (leg) $8.25 million club option for 2027 on Sunday, Ari Alexander of 7 News Boston reports.
data.name: Garrett Whitlock

data.detail: The Red Sox announced Thursday that Durbin (finger) underwent a successful partial excision of the fifth metatarsal base with tendon repair on his right foot, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
data.name: Caleb Durbin

data.detail: Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow said Monday that Anthony is not expected to require surgery on his injured right hand, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
data.name: Roman Anthony

data.detail: Gasper is expected to be sidelined 4-to-6 month after undergoing distal right biceps tendon surgery Friday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.
data.name: Mickey Gasper
